2609.29396.title: Wearable ECG Quality Assessment: A Deep Learning and Ambulatory Context-Awareness Approach
2609.29396.paper_summary: This paper presents and evaluates a Deep Learning-based (DL-based) Signal Quality Assessment (SQA) model to distinguish between clean and noisy ambulatory Electrocardiograms (ECG). The model is trained on Copenhagen Center for Health Technology-Contextualized Arrhythmia Database (CACHET-CADB), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first ambulatory ECG database with both physical and patient-reported contextual data. The model shows stable performance on different databases such as MIT-databases and the latest PyhsioNet/Cinc Challenge 2021 databases. Subsequently, the paper demonstrates how complicated ECG noise can be investigated by the SQA model and the physical contextual data.
2609.29396.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文提出並評估了一種基於深度學習（DL-based）的信號質量評估（SQA）模型，以區分乾淨和嘈雜的動態心電圖（ECG）。該模型是在哥本哈根健康科技中心的情境性心律不整數據庫（CACHET-CADB）上訓練的，據我們所知，這是第一個同時擁有物理和患者報告的情境數據的動態心電圖數據庫。該模型在不同數據庫上顯示出穩定的性能，例如MIT數據庫和最新的PyhsioNet/Cinc Challenge 2021數據庫。隨後，論文展示了如何通過SQA模型和物理情境數據來研究複雜的ECG噪聲。
